This directory contains the `packages/local/src` files from [OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit, revision 0a36fef](https://github.com/openai/sign-in-with-chatgpt-devkit/tree/0a36fefeb913055c8c7a1a29b63d82b96b2e841a). DualRead modified `models.ts`, `types.ts`, and `responses.ts` to expose the catalog’s reasoning levels and forward the user’s choice. These modifications are distributed under the same OpenAI Noncommercial License. The license and third-party notices accompany the source. The build bundles the library into `runtime/host.cjs`.
